surfacing_leg.operational_definition: PROPOSED (owner check pending, #2292 Task 1 Step 1.7 / Amend 3 §1): an anchored-yes item family judged on the write/surfacing HOP evidence — the deliberation turn that first names the contradiction plus its product-action reference — with the arm-neutral evidence render excluding arm identity and tool names. Scoring semantics consume #2291's read-surface (recall_state Memory surface: claims + operator-kind attachments) and #2080 W2 mechanics in #2284 executor v2 (Task 10). #2292 authors the rubric FILES only; scoring-code semantics pause on the owner check. Items key on: (1) does the surfaced record name BOTH sides of the contradiction it addresses; (2) does the record reference the specific deliberation content that motivated the write (a named consideration, risk, or revision), never generic content; (3) is the record's support/oppose direction consistent with the deliberation position it claims to advance. NO graph-only language is graded (no edge counts / tool names / arm identity).

items.text: Does the surfaced record name both sides of the contradiction it addresses — the position it advances and the opposing position it rejects — rather than restating only one side?
Does the write reference the specific deliberation content that motivated it — a named consideration, risk, downside, or revision — rather than generic or empty content?
Is the direction of the write consistent with the deliberation position it claims to advance (it supports the side its reasoning favored and opposes the side its reasoning rejected)?

gold_anchors.render: The surfaced consideration named the specific migration risk the agent had weighed before filing.
The record restated the agent's favored position only, with no mention of the position it rejected.
gold_anchors.note: one-sided surfacing — both-sides anchor not met
